leadText:
For the challenger of Team Rocket's fake Gym in Sinnoh, see Jeffrey.
 

Jeff (Japanese: ジェフ Jeff) is a character of the day who appeared in Team Eevee and the Pokémon Rescue Squad!. He is the father of Davy and Virgil, and the founder of the Pokémon Rescue Squad.

He first appeared when Virgil, , and were going to his office regarding the whereabouts of Davy. Jeff told him and the group that there was a situation regarding many Cryogonal at the dam. When Davy was trapped inside a building located there, Jeff wanted to go and rescue him, but Virgil told him to stay behind. In that case, he had Virgil and the group go to the dam and rescue him. He was last seen waving his farewells to Ash and the gang while they set off to Vertress City.

==Trivia==
Jeff is likely based on from the 1960's TV series , who is also the founder and leader of a rescue organization, with his sons doing the actual rescuing while he supervises and coordinates the rescue missions from the base.
In addition, Jeff's second-oldest son is named in the TV show as well.
